title: Benefit Card Payment Instrument
description: A benefit card processed outside the card networks, such as a US EBT card. One physical card that carries several programs appears as one instrument per program. Any PIN is entered by the buyer in the payment handler's own secure field; it never appears in a UCP payload, and platforms and agents MUST NOT collect it.

type.description: Indicates this is a benefit card payment instrument.

display.description: Display information for this benefit card payment instrument.

last_digits.description: Last 4 digits of the card number.

issuer_region.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or ISO 3166-2 code of the issuing jurisdiction (for example 'US-TX'). Presentational only.
